description: Live webcam session (~80 s) of repeated attempts: several too-short holds of open palm + fist (2.0, 0.7, 0.7, 2.8 s) and fist + scissors (2.4, 1.4 s), then a full fist + scissors hides the pose diagram (~20.7 s), a full open palm + fist stops (~46.5 s), a 2.7 s open palm + scissors is too short, and a full one resumes (~74.4 s). The pose diagram stays hidden after resuming (resuming doesn't change it); the person then walks out of view (~77.4 s).
